parameters.help_en:
The token that specifies the starting position of the next page.

If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the first page by default
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识下一个分页的起始位置的 Token。

当不传时，默认从第一页开始查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 20.

The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页的最大记录数。

当不传递时默认为20。

限制最大值不超过100
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter field. Valid values:

AuthorizationRuleId: The ID of the authorization rule.
AuthorizationRuleNameStartWith: The prefix of the authorization rule name
fields.help_zh:
过滤字段名称。取值可选范围：

AuthorizationRuleId：授权规则 ID。
AuthorizationRuleNameStartWith：授权规则名称左匹配值
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The list of values for the filter field
fields.name: value

AuthorizationResourceScope.description_en:
The scope of authorized resources. Valid values:
custom: Resources within the specified project scope
AuthorizationResourceScope.description_zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
custom：指定项目范围下的资源

AuthorizationRuleCreationType.description_en:
The creation type of the authorization rule. Valid values:
system_init: Created by the system.
user_custom: Created by a user
AuthorizationRuleCreationType.description_zh:
授权规则的创建类型。取值可选范围：
system_init：系统创建
user_custom：用户创建

AuthorizationRuleId.description_en: The ID of the authorization rule

AuthorizationRuleName.description_en: The name of the authorization rule

AuthorizationRuleScenarioLabel.description_en:
The scenario label of the authorization rule. Valid values:
privileged_cloud_account: Privileged cloud account scenario.
asset: Asset scenario
AuthorizationRuleScenarioLabel.description_zh:
授权规则场景标签，枚举值：
privileged_cloud_account（特权云账号场景）
asset（资产场景）

AuthorizationRuleSubjectId.description_en: The ID of the subject associated with the authorization rule
AuthorizationRuleSubjectId.description_zh: 授权规则关联的主体 ID

AuthorizationRuleSubjectScope.description_en:
The subject scope of the authorization rule. Valid values:
shared: Shared. A single rule can be used by multiple subjects that meet the rule constraints.
exclusive: Exclusive. A single rule can only be used by the specified subject
AuthorizationRuleSubjectScope.description_zh:
授权规则的主体范围。取值如下。
shared：共享型，同一条规则可供多个符合规则约束的主体使用。
exclusive：专属类型，同一条规则仅供指定主体使用

AuthorizationRuleSubjectType.description_en:
The subject type applicable to the authorization rule. For an exclusive rule, this field indicates the type of the specified subject. For a shared rule with a specified subject type, this field indicates the subject types that the rule can be associated with. Valid values:
application: Application.
user: Account. For a shared privileged cloud account rule, this value indicates the human user type and can be associated with accounts, user groups, and organizational units.
If the subject type is not specified for the rule, this field may be empty. The actual subjects associated with a shared rule are subject to the query results of subject associations
AuthorizationRuleSubjectType.description_zh:
授权规则适用的主体类别。专属规则中，该字段表示指定主体的类型。已设置主体类别的共享规则中，该字段表示规则允许关联的主体类别。取值如下。
application：应用。
user：账户。对于共享型特权云账号规则，该值表示人用类别，可关联账户、用户组和组织机构。
规则未设置主体类别时，该字段可能为空。共享规则实际关联的主体以主体关联查询结果为准

CreateTime.title_en: 创建时间, 毫秒时间
CreateTime.title_zh: 创建时间, 毫秒时间

disabled: The rule is disabled

enabled：启用
disabled：禁用

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
